title: Mini Major Moisture Smoothing and Hydrating Tinted Lip Balm Trio Makeup Gift Set
descriptionHtml:
What it is: A limited-edition gift set of smoothing lip balms in three must-have minis: Espresso, Cookie Butter, and Mint Mocha.

Highlighted Ingredients:
- Peptides: Stimulate collagen production for visibly plumped, contoured, and volumized lips.
- Bakuchiol: Improves pigmentation to smooth and soften lips.
- Sweet Almond & Coconut Oil: Intensely moisturize lips.

Ingredient Callouts: Free of parabens, formaldehydes, formaldehyde-releasing agents, phthalates, mineral oil, retinyl palmitate, oxybenzone, coal tar, hydroquinone, sulfates SLS & SLES, triclocarban, triclosan, and contains less than one percent synthetic fragrance.

What Else You Need to Know: It's the lip balm formula you know and love, now in a limited-e
How to Use+
Suggested Usage:
-Generously apply to lips for an irresistible wash of shine, moisture, and flavor.
-Apply before glam for a moisturizing prep step, then reapply at the end for the perfect finishing touch.

Artistry tip:
For a more full-coverage lip, layer over any shade of Precision Lip Crayon (sold separately) or Major Headlines Matte Suede Lipstick (sold separately).
Ingredients+
-Peptides: Stimulate collagen production for visibly plumped, contoured, and volumized lips.
-Bakuchiol: Improves pigmentation to smooth and soften lips.
-Sweet Almond & Coconut Oil: Intensely moisturize lips.

Cookie Butter:
Hydrogenated Polyisobutene, Diisostearyl Malate, Microcrystalline Wax, Octyldodecanol, Hydrogenated Poly(C6-14 Olefin), Hydrogenated Styrene/Isoprene Copolymer, Caprylic/Capric Triglyceride, Polyglyceryl-2 Triisostearate, Dimer Dilinoleyl Dimer Dilinoleate, Fragrance (Parfum), Ethylhexyl Palmitate, Phenoxyethanol, Tocopherol, Tribehenin, Tocopheryl Acetate, Hydrogenated Styrene/Butadiene Copolymer, Hydrogenated Coconut Oil, Prunus Amygdalus Dulcis (Sweet Almond) Oil, Stevia Rebaudiana Extract, Dipalmitoyl Hydroxyproline, Sorbitan Isostearate, Benzyl Benzoate, Bakuchiol, Lactic Acid, Pentaerythrityl Tetra-Di-T-Butyl Hydroxyhydrocinnamate, Citral, Limonene, Palmitoyl Tripeptide-1, Anise Alcohol, Benzyl Alcohol, Titanium Dioxide (Ci 77891), Iron Oxides (Ci 77492), Iron Oxides (Ci 77499), Red 7 (Ci 15850).

Espresso:
Hydrogenated Polyisobutene, Diisostearyl Malate, Microcrystalline Wax, Octyldodecanol, Hydrogenated Poly(C6-14 Olefin), Hydrogenated Styrene/Isoprene Copolymer, Caprylic/Capric Triglyceride, Dimer Dilinoleyl Dimer Dilinoleate, Polyglyceryl-2 Triisostearate, Fragrance (Parfum), Ethylhexyl Palmitate, Phenoxyethanol, Vanillin, Tocopherol, Tribehenin, Tocopheryl Acetate, Stevia Rebaudiana Extract, Hydrogenated Styrene/Butadiene Copolymer, Hydrogenated Coconut Oil, Prunus Amygdalus Dulcis (Sweet Almond) Oil, Dipalmitoyl Hydroxyproline, Sorbitan Isostearate, Bakuchiol, Lactic Acid, Pentaerythrityl Tetra-Di-T-Butyl Hydroxyhydrocinnamate, Benzaldehyde, Palmitoyl Tripeptide-1, Iron Oxides (Ci 77491), Iron Oxides (Ci 77499), Red 7 (Ci 15850).

Mint Mocha:
